tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250phur pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300chos dbyings klong yangs gdal khyab zhing khams na// dpal ldan kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// ka dag chos sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs// lhun grub longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gang 'dul sprul sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// dge slong dri med grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// chos rgyal in+d+ra bo dhi la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i bka' chen babs par byin gyis rlobs// rig 'dzin ro langs bde ba la gsol ba 'debs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// dha na saṃskṛta la gsol ba 'debs// gsang sngags zab don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro don phyogs med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// smon lam las 'phro thob par byin gyis rlobs// thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs lnga la gsol ba 'debs// 'ja' lus rdo rjer grol bar byin gyis rlobs// gu ru rat+na gling pa la gsol ba 'debs// rigs drug skye sgo chod par byin gyis rlobs// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rang zhal mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// yi dam phur pa'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// chos skyong phur srung tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// bka' brgyud bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// yi dam lha yis dngos grub bstsal du gsol// chos skyong srung mas bar chad bsal du gsol// sgrub pa mtha' ru 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// don gnyis mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs//
zhes phur pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni sras mchog tshe dbang grags pas mdzad pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
